method.seed: component containing the OSW-D1 anchor on its 2026-07-23 qualifying start date
method.lineage: in each adjacent daily field, select the component inheriting the greatest number of exact pixels
method.minimum_overlap: at least one exact native-grid pixel; all overlap fractions are reported
method.split_policy: follow the greatest-intersection child and report the number of overlapping candidates
method.merge_policy: accept the inherited component and expose overlap dilution through current-inherited fraction

preceding.reason: no active component shares any exact pixel with the following lineage footprint

following.reason: no active component inherits any exact pixel from the preceding lineage footprint

identity_evaluation.test: Every adjacent daily footprint in the declared lineage inherits native pixels from its predecessor under one governed split/merge rule.
identity_evaluation.finding: 21 daily footprints form one explicit primary-overlap lineage from 2026-07-21 through 2026-08-10.

boundary: A grid-overlap lineage of thresholded surface states, not a materially advected water body. One-pixel overlap is permissive; reported IoU and inheritance minima reveal weak links. The lineage is censored wherever it reaches the 32-day source window. Alternative connectivity, size, overlap, split, and merge policies may produce different systems.
